pages.text: The casting basin turns molten material into solid items. Pipe the fluid into it from any face; it holds $(item)1000 mB$(). $(l)How a cast works - Once the basin holds enough fluid for a recipe, it starts counting.$() $(li)For steel:

$(item)144 mB$() and $(item)200 ticks$() (10 s) make $(item)one steel ingot$(). $(li)The ingot stays in the basin. The basin holds $(item)one item$() and does not start the next cast until it is taken out.$(br2)$(l)Taking the result$()$(li)By hand: $(item)right-click with an empty hand$().$(li)Automatically: a $(item)funnel$() or a $(item)hopper$() pulls it out.

The basin $(item)refuses inserted items$(): it only takes fluids, so a funnel next to it only ever extracts.$(br2)The tank takes any fluid. Fluid with no casting recipe just sits there, so keep each basin on a clean line.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
